verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that Helicone webhooks fire when requests complete, so you can run your own code to 'score responses' and do 'real-time evaluation' for quality, safety, and relevance. That custom scoring logic lives in your own external webhook handler, not in a documented scorer framework inside Helicone. missing for 10: a first-party API/SDK for defining custom code-based scorers or metrics, documentation on writing scores back to Helicone, a way to run scorers against eval datasets/experiments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
